BS.Settings.ThemeAccent.Name: Primary color (gold)
BS.Settings.ThemeAccent.Hint: Accent color used for highlighted text and borders across all modules (hex code, e.g. #f0d9a3).
BS.Settings.ThemeAccentDim.Name: Secondary color (dim gold)
BS.Settings.ThemeAccentDim.Hint: A more subdued variant of the primary color, used for borders and less prominent elements.
BS.Settings.ThemeBgTop.Name: Background — gradient top
BS.Settings.ThemeBgTop.Hint: Top color of the background gradient used by panels and buttons (hex code).
BS.Settings.ThemeBgBottom.Name: Background — gradient bottom
BS.Settings.ThemeBgBottom.Hint: Bottom color of the background gradient used by panels and buttons (hex code).
BS.Settings.EnablePartyList.Name: Enable: Party List
BS.Settings.EnablePartyList.Hint: Dockable panel listing the party, featured NPCs, notes, image sharing, and combat tracking. Requires a page reload after changing.
BS.Settings.EnableDiceTray.Name: Enable: Dice Tray
BS.Settings.EnableDiceTray.Hint: Small floating, collapsible dice tray at the bottom of the screen. Requires a page reload after changing.
BS.Settings.EnableChat.Name: Enable: Chat reskin
BS.Settings.EnableChat.Hint: Transparency, contrast, and roll mode icons for the native chat tab. Requires a page reload after changing.
BS.Settings.EnableUi.Name: Enable: UI decluttering
BS.Settings.EnableUi.Hint: Hides logo/navigation/hotbar, shrinks the scene control toolbar. Requires a page reload after changing.
BS.Settings.EnableCombatUi.Name: Enable: Combat action bar
BS.Settings.EnableCombatUi.Hint: Solasta-style action bar (Attack, Spells, Powers...). Requires a page reload after changing.
BPL.Title: Party
BPL.Settings.ShowOffline.Name: Show offline players
BPL.Settings.ShowOffline.Hint: If disabled, only currently connected players appear in the panel.
BPL.Settings.ShowGM.Name: Show GM
BPL.Settings.ShowGM.Hint: Also displays the character assigned to the Game Master, if any.
BPL.Settings.HideDefault.Name: Hide default player list
BPL.Settings.HideDefault.Hint: Hides Foundry's native bottom-left player list tab.
BPL.Settings.AllowResize.Name: Allow manual resizing
BPL.Settings.AllowResize.Hint: Shows a corner handle to freely resize the panel with the mouse (in addition to the expand button).
BPL.Settings.BackgroundOpacity.Name: Panel background opacity
BPL.Settings.BackgroundOpacity.Hint: Adjusts the panel's background transparency, from 0% (fully transparent, default) to 100% (opaque). In docked mode, the background never blocks clicks to the scene underneath — only interactive elements (list, buttons, tabs…) remain clickable.
BPL.Notes.Placeholder: Jot down your ideas, clues, or personal reminders here…
BPL.Share.DropHint: Drop an image here (from your computer or another app) to instantly share it with all players.
BPL.Share.NoValidImage: No valid image was detected in the dropped item.
BPL.Share.UploadError: Failed to upload the image to the server.
BPL.Combat.Title: Combat
BPL.Combat.EndCombatConfirmContent: This will delete the current combat and its initiative order. This action cannot be undone.
BPL.Npc.AlreadyAdded: {name} is already in the featured NPC list.
BPL.Actions.Title: Quick Actions
BPL.Actions.Reset: Reset to default (equipped items, active features, prepared spells)
BPL.Actions.Empty: No actions yet. Drag an item from your sheet, or click reset.
BPL.Actions.NoCharacter: No character is assigned to you.
BPL.Actions.DropWrongActor: You can only add items from your own character.
BPL.Actions.DragHint: Drag an item from your character sheet to add it here.
BPL.Combat.NoPermission: You don't have permission to advance combat — ask the GM.
BDT.Settings.VerticalOffset.Name: Vertical offset
BDT.Settings.VerticalOffset.Hint: Distance (in pixels) between the bottom of the screen and the dice tray. Increase this if it overlaps the macro hotbar.
BC.Settings.BackgroundOpacity.Name: Chat background opacity
BC.Settings.BackgroundOpacity.Hint: Adjusts the chat tab's background transparency, from 0% (fully transparent) to 100% (opaque).
BC.Settings.CompactInput.Name: Compact text input
BC.Settings.CompactInput.Hint: Reduces the height and padding of the chat message text box.
BC.Settings.IconRollMode.Name: Icon roll mode selector
BC.Settings.IconRollMode.Hint: Replaces the native dropdown ("Self Roll", etc.) with a row of clickable icons.
BUI.Settings.HideLogo.Name: Hide Foundry logo
BUI.Settings.HideLogo.Hint: Hides the Foundry logo (top-left), purely decorative. No reopen button is offered: re-enable only via this setting.
BUI.Settings.HideNavForPlayers.Name: Hide scene navigation (players)
BUI.Settings.HideNavForPlayers.Hint: Hides the scene navigation bar at the top of the screen, for players only (the GM still sees it).
BUI.Settings.HideHotbar.Name: Hide macro hotbar
BUI.Settings.HideHotbar.Hint: Hides the macro hotbar at the bottom of the screen. A button lets you show/hide it at any time.
BUI.Settings.CompactControls.Name: Compact tool icons
BUI.Settings.CompactControls.Hint: Reduces the size of the scene control toolbar icons (on the left).
BUI.Settings.ControlGroupsMenu.Name: Default visible tools
BUI.Settings.ControlGroupsMenu.Label: Choose tools
BUI.Settings.ControlGroupsMenu.Hint: Check the scene toolbar groups (on the left) to show by default. Unchecked groups stay hidden until you click the "eye" button (temporary reveal).
BUI.ConfigPanel.Empty: No tool group detected yet. Open a scene first, then try again.
BCU.Settings.AutoOpen.Name: Auto-open on combat start
BCU.Settings.AutoOpen.Hint: Automatically opens the action bar right when a combat begins (once, not every turn).
BCU.Settings.BarScale.Name: Action bar size
BCU.Settings.BarScale.Hint: Enlarges or shrinks the combat action bar and its buttons (100% = normal size).
BCU.ToggleTitle: Show / hide the combat action bar
BCU.NoCharacter: No character is assigned to you.
BCU.NoPermission: You don't have permission to advance combat — ask the GM.
BCU.Generic.NoItemTooltip: No matching item found on the sheet: this declares the action in chat (with the rule text if available), with no automatic mechanical effect.
BCU.EmptyCategoryTooltip: No option available in this category.
